description: The personal and household sustain. Tracks shared finances (liquid balance, budget pockets, income, savings goals), household members, calendar events, and alerts. The primary sustain for individual and family financial sovereignty on Sustena XII.

liquid.description: Unallocated liquid balance — money not yet assigned to any pocket.

pockets.description: Named budget pockets keyed by pocket name. Each pocket holds a portion of allocated funds. Storage matches budget.py which keys pockets by name (finances.pockets.<name>).

allocated.description: Total moved into this pocket from liquid

income.description: Income tracking — most recent recording per source.

goals.description: Savings goals tracked by the household.

tasks.description: Household task list managed by homestead.tasks.* operators.

alerts.description: System and operative-generated alerts for household members.

operators.name: budget.record_income
operators.description: Record an income transaction and credit the liquid balance.

operators.name: budget.allocate
operators.description: Move an amount from liquid balance into a named budget pocket.

operators.name: budget.add_pocket
operators.description: Create a new, empty budget pocket. No money movement.

operators.name: budget.spend
operators.description: Record a spend against a pocket.

operators.name: budget.transfer
operators.description: Move an amount from one pocket to another.

operators.name: budget.summary
operators.description: Return a budget ring ResponseWidget showing all pockets and key metrics.

operators.name: homestead.calendar.add_event
operators.description: Add an event to the household calendar. Date must be in the future.

operators.name: homestead.calendar.upcoming_events
operators.description: Return upcoming calendar events within the next N days.

operators.name: homestead.calendar.remove_event
operators.description: Remove a calendar event by its ID.

operators.name: homestead.tasks.add
operators.description: Add a new task to the household task list.

operators.name: homestead.tasks.complete
operators.description: Mark a task as completed by its ID.

operators.name: homestead.tasks.list
operators.description: List tasks filtered by status window.

operators.name: homestead.tasks.carryover
operators.description: Mark all overdue active tasks as carryover. Runs on a polling schedule.

operators.name: egress.prepare_household_summary
operators.description: Prepare a household finance summary for export. Queued in the outbox as 'prepared' — nothing leaves the system until a human confirms it.

invariants.description: Liquid balance can never go below zero. budget.allocate enforces this before mutating state.
No pocket may have a negative allocated amount. Transfer and allocate operators enforce this.

enforcement._note: Opt-in per Slice 2 rollout discipline. Both invariants above compile clean against state_schema and are already respected by every current operator's own guards — this is a last-line-of-defense gate, not expected to trip in normal use.

aggregates.description: Computed: sum of every linked habitat's finances.liquid.balance. Never persisted — folded fresh from live children on every read (Slice 8, roll-up ρ). Purely observational: never gates a child's or the parent's own operator calls (see _compile_spec_invariants' 'enforced' flag) — the parent observes its children, it never vetoes them.

_composition_notes.history: Formerly a 'habitats' block (prune-and-habitat slice scaffolding — structural declaration only, sustain_id always null, roll-up PENDING). Renamed to the generic 'declared_children' convention in the composition/coordination slice (Slice 8) so the engine's link_child()/provision_declared_children()/compute_rollup() machinery carries zero homestead-specific vocabulary — a future structurally-unlike parent (e.g. an Amber pool, M3) declares its own children the exact same way, with zero engine changes.
_composition_notes.live_links: Actual parent/child links live in the sustain_composition table, keyed by the live homestead sustain_id — never written back into this template file. Call GET /devui/sustain/{id}/children (or SustainEngine.list_children()/compute_rollup()) for the current, real linkage and roll-up; this file only describes what SHOULD be provisioned via provision_declared_children(), not what IS provisioned right now.

curated_widgets.description: Surfaces a pocket right after a spend lands against it, so the person sees the consequence at the moment it happens rather than hunting for it later.
A transaction the transducer captured but couldn't confidently route to a pocket or operator — needs a human decision.
The household's baseline liquid position and, when linked children exist, their rolled-up total — the default at-a-glance card.

parameters.name: owner_ids
parameters.description: List of user IDs who have owner (Level 0) access to this sustain. Required at instantiation — at least one owner must be specified.

parameters.name: initial_income
parameters.description: Starting monthly income amount (KES). Used during onboarding to seed finances.income.amount. Defaults to 0 if not provided.

parameters.name: initial_goal_name
parameters.description: Name of the first savings goal (e.g. 'Emergency fund'). Optional — collected during onboarding flow.

parameters.name: initial_goal_amount
parameters.description: Target amount for the first savings goal (KES). Only used if initial_goal_name is also provided.

parameters.name: initial_goal_deadline
parameters.description: Target date for the first savings goal (ISO 8601 date). Only used if initial_goal_name is also provided.

_notes.calendar_operators_implemented: homestead.calendar.add_event, homestead.calendar.upcoming_events, and homestead.calendar.remove_event are implemented in sustena/operators/calendar.py (Epic 1.3.1).
_notes.pocket_schema_reconciled: pockets is now declared as a dict keyed by pocket name to match budget.py's actual storage pattern (finances.pockets.<name>). Reconciled in Epic 1.3.1.
_notes.council_operatives_implemented: protege, navigator, and attache operatives are implemented in sustena/operatives/ (Epic 1.3.1).
